-63.60000,-16.30000.type: organism not named in the title, national biosafety decision
-63.60000,-16.30000.desc: A decision on a living modified organism, filed by the country itself to the Biosafety Clearing-House. Article 20 of the Cartagena Protocol requires every party to file its release and market decisions there within fifteen days, and 173 parties are bound by it. The United States is not among them. Nowhere else holds national release decisions from this many countries in one place. A country with no records here has not necessarily approved nothing — it may not have filed, and from the outside those two look the same.

-79.96070,40.43700.name: University of Pittsburgh Physicians, Center for Fertility and Reproductive Endocrinology
-79.96070,40.43700.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Julie M. Rios, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-2.56718,51.54112.name: Bristol Centre for Reproductive Medicine
-2.56718,51.54112.state: 135 Aztec West, Park Avenue, Almondsbury, Bristol, BS32 4UB, United Kingdom
-2.56718,51.54112.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-62.22874,-38.72758.name: CER Centro Especializado en ReproducciÃ³n
-62.22874,-38.72758.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.cermed.com. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

7.60600,47.54800.name: Syngenta — seedcare & seeds portfolio
7.60600,47.54800.desc: The coatings and treatments applied to seed before it is sold, including neonicotinoid insecticides. This layer travels with every bag and mostly escapes pesticide-use reporting, because nothing is sprayed and so nothing is recorded. By area treated it is among the largest insecticide applications in world agriculture, and among the least documented — a whole category of use the statistics simply do not see.

24.83000,60.19000.name: Onego Bio
24.83000,60.19000.desc: Ferments engineered fungi to make egg white protein, with US regulatory clearance in 2025. Finland and Denmark have become a centre for this because the fermentation infrastructure was already there for industrial enzymes, which is a good illustration of how this industry grows out of the one before it.

2.63330,50.51670.name: Staphyt
2.63330,50.51670.desc: A European agroscience contractor holding a network of officially recognised trial stations, with field agronomists and project managers who test both products and varieties for performance, efficacy and safety, and a regulatory affairs department that designs the studies. Its own description of the arrangement is the useful part: the two capabilities are combined so a client can be supported from early development through to launch. A study designed by the same firm that will argue it through a regulator is a different object from one designed to find out.
